question: In which year did the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) succeed in forging an agreement to freeze CFC production at 1986 levels?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1987.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• In **1987**, the **United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP)** succeeded in forging an agreement to freeze CFC production at **1986 **levels.
 
• In 1987, in an attempt to save the ozone layer, the UNEP forged an agreement between its member countries to **freeze the production of chlorofluorocarbons at 1986 levels**.
 
• United Nations act to control the production of **chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs)** used in refrigerators as **the CFCs depletes the ozone layer that protect from UV radiation from the Sun and directly reaches the earth**.
 
• UNEP's mission is to provide leadership and encourage partnership in** caring for the environment.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a947ff9c17beee6f15afccb9d1c0959074045696d341f10e0957b9da8297a979.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **UNESCO:** United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization. 
 
• The United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) was born on 16 November 1945. 
 
• **The United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF)**, originally called as the United Nations International Children's Emergency Fund.
